summary: Firebase Auth signup succeeds but Firestore profile document creation is blocked by security rules; project needs a production-critical rules fix to allow authenticated users to create their own profile document (uid matches userId).
architectural_notes: HOT-LOCKED: Do not change signup flow logic or admin/helper logic; only adjust Firestore security rules to permit authenticated users to create their own profile document where request.auth.uid == userId.
known_issues: Signup fails at Firestore profile write step with “Missing or insufficient permissions” because Firestore rules do not allow new authenticated users to create their own profile document; profile photo/name/phone/email not saved.

existing_features.title: Update Firestore security rules to allow a newly authenticated user to CREATE their own profile document during signup by permitting writes when `request.auth != null` and `request.auth.uid == userId` for the profile document path used by the app (`users/{userId}`). Do not change any signup flow logic, admin/helper logic, or add new features.

projectName: Fix Firestore security rules to allow authenticated users to create their own profile document
